![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5622cd82e4b0501d40689558/745cbb64-4d28-4b69-9e21-efe08bf38ba8/unitedeffortorganization.png){width=400px}

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd

# Read the quarterly metrics CSV
metrics_df = pd.read_csv('quarterly_metrics.csv')

# Format the dataframe for display
display_df = metrics_df.copy()

# Dynamically get numeric columns (all columns except 'Type of Metric')
numeric_cols = [col for col in display_df.columns if col != 'Type of Metric']

# Convert columns to proper types - int for all except Onsite Volunteer hours
for col in numeric_cols:
    formatted_values = []
    for idx, metric_name in enumerate(display_df['Type of Metric']):
        value = display_df.loc[idx, col]
        if metric_name == 'Onsite Volunteer hours':
            formatted_values.append(float(value))
        else:
            formatted_values.append(int(float(value)))
    display_df[col] = formatted_values

# Display as a styled HTML table
import IPython.display as ipd

header_cols = list(display_df.columns)

# Build styled HTML table with UEO brand colors
html = '''<style>
#ueo-metrics { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; margin: 1.5em 0; }
#ueo-metrics th { background: #4B2E83; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 14px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid #3a2366; }
#ueo-metrics th:not(:first-child) { text-align: right; }
#ueo-metrics td { padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid #d1d1d1; }
#ueo-metrics td:not(:first-child) { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
#ueo-metrics tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #f7f5fb; }
#ueo-metrics tbody tr:nth-child(odd) { background: #fff; }
#ueo-metrics tbody tr:hover { background: #ede8f5; }
</style>
<table id="ueo-metrics">
<thead><tr>'''

for col in header_cols:
    html += f'<th>{col}</th>'
html += '</tr></thead>\n<tbody>\n'

for _, row in display_df.iterrows():
    html += '<tr>'
    for col in header_cols:
        value = row[col]
        if col == 'Type of Metric':
            html += f'<td>{value}</td>'
        elif row['Type of Metric'] == 'Onsite Volunteer hours':
            html += f'<td>{value:,.2f}</td>'
        else:
            html += f'<td>{int(value):,}</td>'
    html += '</tr>\n'

html += '</tbody></table>'

ipd.display(ipd.HTML(html))
```

### Key Metrics Explained

- **Total number of new clients entered into Apricot**: Total number of new clients engaged during the period
- **Clients signed engagement letter**: Clients who have formally engaged with our services through signed agreements
- **Housing support**: Total housing-related services provided to clients, including housing applications submitted and enrollment in housing programs such as PSH, RRH, HUD-VASH, Section 8, VI-SPDAT assessments, home sharing, and housing recertification
- **Housing applications - Data from Apricot**: Number of Clients & Programs entries that started in the period with a Housing Solution application program in Program Enrolled, such as PSH, RRH, HUD VASH, Section 8 interest list, Housing Choice Voucher, Search, or Home Sharing
- **Housing retention**: Number of Clients & Programs entries that started in the period with Deposit & first month rent, Housing Recertification, Housing Retention, or Homelessness Prevention in Program Enrolled
- **Active Onsite Volunteers**: Unique onsite volunteers present in all 3 months of the quarter. Remote volunteers are not included
- **Onsite Volunteer hours**: Total volunteer hours contributed by onsite volunteers during the period. Remote volunteer hours are not counted
- **Active Clients**: Clients who are actively engaged with UEO services, meaning they have both signed an engagement letter and have an "Active" status
- **Semi-Active Clients**: Clients who use our mailing address, receipt UPLIFT stickers, or Caltrain clipper cards
- **Clients active in Self-Sufficiency Program**: Clients currently participating in UEO's Self-Sufficiency Program who have completed at least one assessment, helping them work toward financial stability and independence
